data.answer: Nimbus Labs holds a current SOC 2 Type II report covering the Nimbus Ledger Sync platform. The audit period ran from 1 January 2026 to 30 June 2026, and the final report was issued on 14 August 2026.
The SOC 2 audit was performed by the independent auditor Harlow & Pike LLP.
Three Trust Services Criteria were examined: Security (common criteria), Availability, and Confidentiality. The Processing Integrity and Privacy criteria were not part of this examination.

The auditor noted two exceptions during the period: one quarterly access review was completed 6 days after the due date in Q1 2026, and one terminated contractor retained read-only access to a staging tool for 2 days after their contract ended. Both exceptions were remediated and closed before the report was issued.

The full report is available to customers and prospects under a signed NDA by sending requests to security@nimbuslabs.example, which are answered within 3 business days. Additionally, a bridge letter covering the period from 1 July 2026 to the date of request can be issued on demand.
Yes, employees sign in through our identity provider using SAML 2.0 single sign-on, and customer administrators can also connect their own SAML 2.0 identity provider to Nimbus Ledger Sync.
Yes, multi-factor authentication is mandatory for every employee account with no exceptions.
An external penetration test is performed once a year by CertiNova.
The most recent test in March 2026 found no critical issues and two medium issues, both of which were fixed within 21 days.
Authenticated vulnerability scans of production run weekly.
